faq.title: FAQ
faq.heroSubtitle: Detailed answers to help you choose lighting and shop with confidence at Osool Altamaioz.
faq.intro: Here are the most common questions about our products, lighting selection, and shopping. For official shipping, warranty, and returns details, see our policy pages or contact us.
faq.q1Answer: We offer indoor, outdoor, and decorative lighting — COB spots, panels, profiles, LED strips, chandeliers, floodlights, switches, sockets, fans, and smart products. Categories are organised by lighting type and use case.
faq.q2Question: Do you offer indoor and outdoor lighting?
faq.q2Answer: Yes. We carry ranges for indoor spaces (rooms, kitchens, majlis) and outdoor (facades, gardens, parking). Browse by category or via Shop By Space.
faq.q3Answer: We offer smart control products, switches, and lighting-related accessories in dedicated categories. See Smart Lighting or Switches & Sockets for details.
faq.q4Question: Are products suitable for homes and commercial projects?
faq.q4Answer: Yes. Our range suits homes, villas, restaurants, retail, and offices. For larger projects, contact us for guidance — without unconfirmed timelines or pricing.
faq.q5Question: How do I choose the right lighting for each room?
faq.q5Answer: Start with the room function: a majlis needs warm layered light, a kitchen needs task lighting, a bedroom needs visual comfort. Use Shop By Space or Lighting Experience for initial guidance.
faq.q6Question: What is the difference between warm, neutral, and cool white light?
faq.q6Answer: Measured in Kelvin (K). 3000K is warm and comfortable for living areas, 4000K is neutral for kitchens and offices, 6500K is cool for detailed tasks. Choice depends on mood and use.
faq.q7Answer: Prefer warm light (2700–3000K) with layers: soft ambient, bedside reading lights, and indirect accent where possible. Avoid direct glare above the bed.
faq.q8Answer: A majlis benefits from a chandelier or central pendant plus spots or profiles for layers. 3000K adds warmth suited to hospitality. Balance seating and wall lighting.
faq.q9Answer: Combine general lighting (often 4000K) with under-cabinet task light and pendants over an island if present. Layering reduces shadows on work surfaces.
faq.q10Question: What lighting suits facades and gardens?
faq.q10Answer: Facades: directed or linear fixtures highlighting architecture. Gardens: path lights and accent on plants and walls. Use suitable outdoor IP ratings — see our outdoor category.
faq.q11Question: Can you help me choose lighting by space?
faq.q11Answer: Yes via Shop By Space, Shop The Scene, Lighting Experience, and the smart assistant. For complex needs, contact us from the Contact page.
faq.q12Answer: K = Kelvin, colour temperature. Lower numbers are warmer (yellow), higher are cooler (white). 3000K warm, 4000K neutral, 6500K cool.
faq.q13Question: What is the difference between spotlights, COB, chandeliers, and linear LED?
faq.q13Answer: Spots: recessed ceiling fixtures. COB: spot technology with smoother light distribution. Chandeliers: central decorative pieces. Linear LED (profile/strip): continuous light in ceilings or cabinets.
faq.q14Question: How do I know how many fixtures a space needs?
faq.q14Answer: Depends on area, ceiling height, and activity. Kitchens and offices generally need higher lux than bedrooms. Lighting Experience gives initial recommendations — for precise projects consult a specialist.
faq.q15Question: Do recommendations change with wall colour and ceiling height?
faq.q15Answer: Yes. Dark walls absorb more light and may need extra sources. High ceilings need stronger or directed light. Try Lighting Experience to preview wall colour impact.
faq.q16Question: Can I use more than one lighting type in the same room?
faq.q16Answer: Yes — and it is recommended. Combine ambient, task, and accent layers for flexibility and depth.
faq.q17Question: How do I order from the store?
faq.q17Answer: Browse products, select variants (CCT, wattage, finish), add to cart, then checkout from the cart page. You may need an account or guest details depending on available payment options.
faq.q18Question: Can I add multiple products to the cart?
faq.q18Answer: Yes. Add several products and adjust quantities on the cart page before checkout.
faq.q19Question: Can I save a wishlist and return later?
faq.q19Answer: Yes. Use the wishlist icon on products. When signed in, your list is saved to your account.
faq.q20Answer: Yes via Track Order with order number and email, or from My Orders in your account after sign-in.
faq.q21Question: Do you offer consultations or product selection help?
faq.q21Answer: We provide in-store guidance tools (Lighting Experience, smart assistant) and you can contact us for enquiries. We do not promise site visits or unconfirmed pricing.
faq.q22Question: Are your products suitable for homes and projects?
faq.q22Answer: Yes. Our range covers residential and commercial use. For large projects, contact us with your requirements.
faq.q23Question: Do you have a varied selection?
faq.q23Answer: Yes — multiple categories from COB spots to chandeliers, outdoor, and smart lighting. The range expands as new products are approved.
faq.q24Question: Can I contact you if I am unsure which product to choose?
faq.q24Answer: Absolutely. Use Contact us or the smart assistant. Have room size, use case, and any CCT preference ready.
faq.q25Question: What if I need help after purchase?
faq.q25Answer: Contact us with your order number. For official policies (warranty, returns, shipping) see policy pages — some details may be pending confirmation.
faq.q26Question: Can I get more product details before buying?
faq.q26Answer: Yes. The product page shows specifications and variants. If information is missing, contact us before purchase.
faq.q27Question: How do I confirm a product suits my use?
faq.q27Answer: Review specs (CCT, wattage, outdoor IP, mounting type). Compare with Shop By Space or ask the assistant. When in doubt, contact us.
